terms.title: Terms of Service | Smart Sequence Tech
terms.description: ForgeHelm SaaS subscription terms for Core, Professional, and Enterprise plans.

sections.heading: 1. Service Description
paragraphs: {studioNameEn} ({studioName}, "we") provides the ForgeHelm code governance and compliance platform, including the SaaS management platform, the analysis engine (Agent) software, and related modules (compliance reports, SBOM, dashboard, risk questionnaire, AI assistant, tech stack migration, data quality).

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and Responsibilities
bullets: You must provide accurate and complete registration information
You are responsible for account security; accounts must not be shared
Abuse of the service (attacks, spam, excessive automated requests) is prohibited
You are fully responsible for data you upload or submit

sections.heading: 3. Subscriptions, Billing, and Refunds
bullets: ForgeHelm is sold as a per-seat annual subscription (Core, Professional, Enterprise): annual fee = monthly seat rate × number of seats × 12 + annual platform fee (Professional / Enterprise)
Online payment is completed via Stripe Checkout on the ForgeHelm SaaS platform; enterprise procurement may use contracts, purchase orders, or wire transfer
Trial fees are fully credited toward the first year's fee if you upgrade to a Core or Professional annual subscription within 30 days of payment

Seats may be added during the contract term and are prorated for the remaining period; seat reductions take effect at the next renewal. Where monthly billing is offered, seat fees are typically about 20% higher than annual billing
Listed prices exclude tax; Taiwan customers are charged 5% VAT in addition and receive a government uniform invoice (seller's tax ID: {taxId})
Annual subscriptions are generally non-refundable once activated unless required by law or agreed in writing; service remains available through the end of the subscription term

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
bullets: Compliance reports, SBOMs, and dashboard data generated from your repositories by the analysis engine are owned by you, and you may freely use, distribute, and provide them to third parties
ForgeHelm platform software, UI, and analysis algorithms are owned by {studioNameEn}
You may not copy, modify, or distribute any part of the service without authorization

sections.heading: 5. Changes and Termination
bullets: We may modify, suspend, or terminate the service
Material changes will be notified by email at least 30 days in advance

If we discontinue the service, we will give advance notice and help you export your data; your own data (including reports and analysis results) can be exported from the platform as JSON/ZIP on any plan

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
bullets: The service is provided "as is" without guarantee of error-free or uninterrupted operation
Reports are for reference only; decisions remain your responsibility
Except in cases of willful misconduct or gross negligence, we are not liable for indirect losses, lost profits, or business interruption arising from use of or inability to use the service

For all other damages, our total liability is capped at the service fees you paid in the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim; for enterprise or government customers purchasing under a written contract, that contract's warranty, liability, and termination terms take precedence over these terms

sections.heading: 7. Governing Law
bullets: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
Disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Taipei District Court as the court of first instance
